CustomField.inlineHelpText: Generate - Continuing to seek whether prospect appears to be a good fit; Qualify – Gathering information to identify services needed; Analyze – Deeper analysis to develop solution options and pricing; Propose – Present solution and work through iterations with client; Contract – Agreement on solution approach; Approve – All final contracts have been signed; Closed Won – Opportunity has been approved; Closed Lost – Decision has been made to not proceed
